opinions.text: Certiorari, 352 U. S. 865, to the United States Court of Appeals for the Seventh Circuit. The motion to substitute B. J. Fallon, Jr., as Executor of the estate of Bernard J. Fallon, deceased, in the place and stead of Bernard J. Fallon, as a party respondent, is granted.
